user: I want to know some tall buildings in New York City
assistant: Sure, here is a list of tall buildings in New York City:

user: what is One World Trade Center?
assistant: One World Trade Center is the main building of the rebuilt World Trade Center complex in Lower Manhattan, New York City. It is the second - tallest freestanding structure building in the Western Hemisphere, and the sixth - tallest in the world. It is also known as 1 World Trade Center, 1 WTC or Freedom Tower. One World Trade Center surpasses the height of Taipei 101, is the world 's tallest all - office building, and the fourth - tallest skyscraper in the world , behind the Burj Khalifa, Abraj Al Bait, and Shanghai Tower.
user: Who built the One World Trade Center and why?
assistant: Daniel R. Tishman, along with his father John Tishman, led the construction team from Tishman Realty & Construction to build the One World Trade Center. It is built to memorialize the September 11 attacks and to rebuild the complex.
user: I want to know who owns it now and if all the spaces in the building are leased out.
assistant: The Port Authority of New York and New Jersey is the primary owner of One World Trade Center. Approximately 5 percent of the building's equity has been sold to the Durst Organization, a private real estate company. Not all the spaces in the building are leased. As of November 2014, the lease occupancy rate had increased to 62.8 percent.
user: How was the location of the One World Trade Center decided?
assistant: The location of the One World Trade Center was originally planned to be on the east side of Lower Manhattan. However, due to disagreements between the New Jersey and New York state governments, which oversee the Port Authority, the location was shifted to the site of the H&M's Hudson Terminal on the Lower West Side of Manhattan after several meetings.
user: how many people exactly participated in this project?
assistant: I do not have specific information on the exact number of people who participated in the construction of One World Trade Center.

how much did it cost in the end comparing to the old original World Trade Center complex?

Due to inflation, we cannot make a direct comparison of the construction costs of both buildings. However, various factors contributed to the total estimated construction cost of One World Trade Center, which had risen to $3.9 billion by April 2012. In comparison, the original World Trade Center complex cost around $900 million to construct.

Welsh language
Janet Davies proposed that the origins of Welsh language were much less definite ; in The Welsh Language : A History , she proposes that Welsh may have been around even earlier than 600 AD . This is evidenced by the dropping of final syllables from Brittonic : * bardos `` poet '' became bardd , and * abona `` river '' became afon . Though both Davies and Jackson cite minor changes in syllable structure and sounds as evidence for the creation of Old Welsh , Davies suggests it may be more appropriate to refer to this derivative language as Lingua Brittanica rather than characterizing it as a new language altogether .

The critics stated that the Port Authority figure was an unrealistically low estimate , and they estimated the project would end up costing $750 million . By the time the World Trade Center twin towers were ultimately completed , the total costs to the Port Authority had reached $900 million .

Apple TV
The second generation Apple TV was unveiled on September 1 , 2010 , and was the first to run on a variant of iOS . The device was now housed in a smaller , all - black case , one - quarter the size of the original . The new model did away with an internal hard drive and had 8 GB internal flash storage , enough local storage for buffering purposes ; all media was now streamed , instead of synced . The new device could also stream rented content from iTunes and video from computers or iOS devices via AirPlay . All content is drawn from online or locally connected sources .
